visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium full shot of a bride in a voluminous white ruffled wedding gown and a groom in a sleek black suit. They are standing in a modern chapel with floor-to-ceiling glass windows that reveal a cloudy sky and ocean view. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor coastal setting where the couple walks along a sandy beach. A staff member holds a black umbrella over them. Large dark rocks and a distant pier are visible in the background. (3) Back inside the chapel, the bride is seen in a medium shot, smiling and looking back towards the camera while holding her gown. The lighting is bright and natural. (4) During a rehearsal phase, the couple stands facing each other in front of the large glass window. The camera pans slightly. (5) The official ceremony begins with the groom entering through large white double doors into the bright chapel hall. Guests are seated on both sides. (6) The bride enters, arm-in-arm with an older man in a brown suit. They walk down the aisle towards the altar. (7) On stage, the couple stands holding hands. In a close-up, they share an emotional embrace and kiss. Yellow flowers decorate the foreground. (8) The scene transitions to a reception dinner. A man in a dark grey suit stands at a podium, speaking into a microphone. (9) The final shots show a compilation of photos of the couple with friends on a green lawn with palm trees near the ocean, followed by a romantic sunset silhouette of the couple.
